description: Phase C fabric completion (ROADMAP.md Phase C; docs/capability-bus.md, Current State caveat). Since the 80 Python-only cutover the KFT `finetune` MCP tool is ADVERTISED but its invoke degrades — the FastAPI service cannot spawn the lugh subprocess the retired Express front did. Re-wire it so finetune dispatches correctly: instead of spawning a local subprocess, route to lugh's published `lugh:agent:finetune` provider over the fabric (MCP/A2A, peer-dialed per koine ADR-0001), retiring the transitional in-process advertisement. CROSS-REPO: resolves when lugh publishes its provider manifest, so this depends on lugh:30-kft-provider-manifest. Scope: the KCB/MCP finetune tool (services/api capability_bus.py, kcb/mcp.py) + the manifest + tests. Serializes with other Phase-C rows on `capability-bus`.

userStories.title: Dispatch finetune to the lugh provider over the fabric
userStories.description: Replace the broken local-subprocess dispatch with a fabric route to lugh:agent:finetune, resolved and peer-dialed via the KINP/KCB surfaces rather than spawned in-process.
acceptanceCriteria: The finetune MCP tool dispatches to lugh's published `lugh:agent:finetune` provider over MCP/A2A (address resolved via the KCB registry, peer-dialed per koine ADR-0001 — no central proxy, no local subprocess spawn), replacing the degraded post-80 path.

The transitional in-process advertisement is retired so the manifest advertises exactly what is dispatchable; a job outside lugh's envelope surfaces the graded refusal that names agora's general trainer.
The applicable gates pass: `uv run --all-packages pytest services/api/tests`, `uv run --all-packages ruff check services/api`, `uv run --directory services/api --all-packages mypy`.

userStories.title: Test the routed finetune invoke hermetically
userStories.description: Pin the re-wired dispatch with a test that uses a stub lugh provider so it needs no live lugh checkout.
acceptanceCriteria: A hermetic test drives a finetune invoke against a stubbed lugh:agent:finetune endpoint and asserts the request is routed (not subprocess-spawned) and the response is surfaced, plus the envelope-refusal path.
`bun run check:contracts` passes if the capability-manifest/contract source changed; the manifest JSON parses.
